answers.core: This would be an improvement to the core functionality of the animation state machines and would make them behave more intuitively when using "At End" transitions.
answers.workaround: It can't be easily worked around without altering how state machines run, as far as I know. Other than the suggestion I mentioned earlier, which also makes the state machines less readable.

title: Only Evaluate Animation State Machine Advanced Expressions At End (for at end transitions)
